goal.decided: The user has the work that the AI they instruct asks for run as much as it can, stopped neither by the usage limit, by waiting for an answer, nor by the session closing: 「目的：AI が頼んだ作業が、できるだけ実行される」「測り方：上限、質問待ち、会話の終了で止まってしまった作業の割合（少ないほど良い）」「A」 Once it holds, the work that AI asks for goes on through the usage limit, with no prompt waiting for an answer, and after the session that asked for it closes, where before each of these stopped it.

deliverables.name: This design tree holds every deliverable the goal needs, each after what it stands on

decisions.about: the request
decisions.decided: #62: issue lovaizu/ccpm#62, which the run closes

decisions.about: whom the goal is for
decisions.decided: One kind of person: the AI that the user instructs, which plans the work. The goal names no way the AI calls overnight, such as through a plugin: 「ユーザーがAIに指示して、AIが段取る、なので利用者はAI」「Aをプラグインで呼び出したら同じだよね？」「（プラグイン経由で呼ばれる場合も含む）要らない 置いた作業？ 作業の中身が許すところ？ 中身以外の理由で止まった？ 意図以外、意味不明では？」

decisions.about: what they can do
decisions.decided: The work the AI asks for runs as much as it can, stopped neither by the usage limit, by waiting for an answer, nor by the session closing. Night and morning are only one way to use it, and taking in the results is not part of what they can do, as results follow from running: 「結果を受け取れるかどうかが目的でなく、できるだけ実行するかどうか、が本質的な目的 実行できれば結果がついてくる 夜とか朝とかどうでもよい、できるだけ実行、これが目的 イメージできますか？」「目的：AI が頼んだ作業が、できるだけ実行される」「測り方：上限、質問待ち、会話の終了で止まってしまった作業の割合（少ないほど良い）」「A」

decisions.about: the steps the user checks
decisions.decided: The first step alone, 目的と意図; each later step is done once its Rounds are over: 「私は目的と意図だけ確認したい、使い方や実装に興味ない、実現して欲しい」

deliverables.name: overnight's developers know whom overnight serves and the one way it keeps the work the AI asks for running as much as it can

decisions.about: Roles
decisions.decided: One role: the AI that the user instructs. Roles say nothing of how it calls overnight, directly or through a plugin, as a plugin that calls overnight is only that AI's way of calling it: 「ユーザーがAIに指示して、AIが段取る、なので利用者はAI」「Aをプラグインで呼び出したら同じだよね？」「（プラグイン経由で呼ばれる場合も含む）要らない 置いた作業？ 作業の中身が許すところ？ 中身以外の理由で止まった？ 意図以外、意味不明では？」「使う人：あなたの指示を受けた AI」「A」

decisions.about: the objective
decisions.decided: The objective says in plain words that the work the AI asks for runs as much as it can, not that it gets done, as whether a piece gets done depends on the work itself. It names no night or morning, and holds no taking in of the results: 「できるだけ実行されること、なのでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」「夜とか朝とかどうでもよい、できるだけ実行、これが目的」「（プラグイン経由で呼ばれる場合も含む）要らない 置いた作業？ 作業の中身が許すところ？ 中身以外の理由で止まった？ 意図以外、意味不明では？」「目的：AI が頼んだ作業が、できるだけ実行される」「A」

decisions.about: Key results
decisions.decided: One key result alone, named in plain words: the share of pieces stopped by the usage limit, a wait for an answer, or the session closing. Lower is better. No key result counts the steps the user takes, and none counts whether a piece succeeds or reaches its end, as that depends on the work itself: 「良し悪しの測り方 違うのでは？ 中身次第の内容を省くと？ できるだけ実行されること、なのでは？ 意図の内容ってそういうことでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」「A なのでロジックだよね」「（プラグイン経由で呼ばれる場合も含む）要らない 置いた作業？ 作業の中身が許すところ？ 中身以外の理由で止まった？ 意図以外、意味不明では？」「測り方：上限、質問待ち、会話の終了で止まってしまった作業の割合（少ないほど良い）」「A」

decisions.about: an objective for taking in the results
decisions.decided: No objective for taking in the results: the one objective and its one key result stand alone, as results follow from running: 「結果を受け取れるかどうかが目的でなく、できるだけ実行するかどうか、が本質的な目的 実行できれば結果がついてくる 夜とか朝とかどうでもよい、できるだけ実行、これが目的 イメージできますか？」

decisions.about: who decides the one way and its ideas
decisions.decided: The maker decides the one way and each idea that carries it from the goal and the run's records, and asks the user none of them, as the user confirms only the purpose and the intent: 「目的はすでに伝えてるよね？ それ手段だよね？」 「私は目的と意図だけ確認したい、使い方や実装に興味ない、実現して欲しい」

decisions.about: what the one way and its ideas serve
decisions.decided: The one way and each idea of the concept serve the key result, keeping the work the AI asks for from stopping by the usage limit, by waiting for an answer, or by the session closing, and the one way promises no piece its end. The concept says it in the same plain words as the objective and the key result. Its three ideas keep their meaning: going on after each reset of the usage limit, handing each piece its tools and its folder up front so that no question waits for an answer, and going on after the session closes: 「意図の内容ってそういうことでは？」「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」「（プラグイン経由で呼ばれる場合も含む）要らない 置いた作業？ 作業の中身が許すところ？ 中身以外の理由で止まった？ 意図以外、意味不明では？」「意図：使用枠の上限で止まっても解除のたびに再開する。質問で止まらないよう、道具と作業フォルダを最初に渡す。会話が閉じても続ける。」「A」

decisions.about: a piece that the usage limit stops again and again
decisions.decided: The concept holds no idea of giving a piece up: such a piece waits out each reset like any other piece.

deliverables.name: An AI that the user instructs learns from the guide alone whether overnight fits its work, and how to ask it for work so that the work runs as much as it can

decisions.about: the length of the opening's sentence of what the AI achieves
decisions.decided: The opening's sentence that starts `With it, you` holds 20 words or fewer, as the readme template's form takes it and the repository's template check refuses the push of a longer one. It says what it says now.

decisions.about: the one way
decisions.decided: Wherever the README states the one way, the opening's first sentence and the figure's alt text included, it says what the concept says: overnight keeps each piece from stopping by the usage limit, a wait for an answer, or the session closing. It promises no piece its end, as whether a piece gets done depends on the work itself: 「最後までかどうかは作業次第だよね、、、」

decisions.about: the length of each answer under How it works
decisions.decided: Each answer under a question of How it works holds one or two sentences, as the readme template's form takes it and the repository's template check refuses the push of a longer one. Each says what it says now.

deliverables.name: overnight's developers build its parts so that together they give what its README promises

decisions.about: a start at a set time
decisions.decided: overnight builds no start at a set time: each piece starts at its hand-over, as the README promises, and the test strategy checks no such start.

decisions.about: the record through a reset
decisions.decided: S1's sequence shows the runner recording the piece as running again when it goes on in its conversation after a reset, so that the status shows a resumed piece as running, and a runner that ends after the resume counts as stopped by the session closing, not by the usage limit.

decisions.about: a piece with a call refused that went on to its end
decisions.decided: A piece whose conversation reached its end counts by how it ended, whatever happened on the way: done where it ended, and failed where it ended by an error of its own. A call refused along the way is no stop and no wait for an answer, and nothing of it is recorded, as a refused call waits on no one and the one key result counts only the pieces that the usage limit, a wait for an answer, or the session closing stopped: 「意味がわからない」「聞いてる意図は？目的は？」「目的から判断したら聞く必要ないよね PVが些末な多数になってなければあなたが判断できるはずなんだけど」

decisions.about: how `claude -p` behaves where a stand-in hides it
decisions.decided: A `claude -p` stopped by the usage limit ends, and its reply holds a line with the time the limit resets, such as `You've hit your session limit · resets 1:40pm`. Given `--add-dir`, it takes the arguments after it as directories, so the prompt goes on stdin.

decisions.about: Test strategy
decisions.decided: No check runs the work through a real night or spends the usage limit on purpose. Each piece of logic that overnight builds, such as the resume after the usage limit resets, the pieces run at once, and the record of each result, is checked by tests with a stand-in in place of `claude`: 「５で実際に夜流すことに意味あるの？上限来るように無駄な作業するの？ ポイントは？上限解除後の再開ロジック、時刻開始、並行数、作業結果の記録、ぐらいじゃないの？全部ロジックだよね？」

decisions.about: when the walkthrough run runs
decisions.decided: overnight is done only once the integration tests with the stand-in pass and then a walkthrough run of the README's request tries `ask` and `status` once, briefly, on the real Claude, as the tests with the stand-in can't show that these two run on it. The run waits for no night and spends no usage limit on purpose: 「A（推奨）自動テストが通った後、本物の Claude で一度だけ短く動かして確認してから完成とする。夜まで待つ必要も、上限に当てる必要もありません。」「A」

decisions.about: how pieces tells that a runner has ended
decisions.decided: The document says how pieces tells that a piece's runner has ended, and which part hands it what it needs to tell so, as an arrow of S1, so that the status counts each piece whose runner is gone as stopped in the share it shows.

decisions.about: how the next piece gets its number
decisions.decided: The document says from what the hand-over takes the next piece's number, so that on each later night, with earlier pieces' branches, worktrees, and records kept or some of them removed, each new piece gets a folder and a branch that no earlier piece holds, and its record's folder carries the same number.

decisions.about: which part looks at the earlier branches and worktrees for the next number
decisions.decided: Hand-over looks at the repository's overnight/<n> branches and worktrees itself, as it makes them, and takes as the next number one more than the highest of these and of the highest number that a record holds, which it asks of pieces. S1 shows the look as one arrow of hand-over to itself, before it makes the piece's folder.

deliverables.name: overnight's developers see, before any body is written, that its parts fit together
overnight's developers see, before any part is built, that its parts joined give each key result, by cases that fail until the parts are built
overnight resumes work after the usage limit resets, runs the pieces at once, and records each result, as its tests show
